summary: Hotelprofessionals is hotelprofessionals is the premier platform for all hotel jobs in the Netherlands!, founded in 2011. About 3 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 4 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06
LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

culture.text: Founded by two Hotelschool The Hague graduates who worked at chains like Hilton and Club Med before starting it.
Staff come from places like Hotelschool The Hague and EFAP, mostly in business development and operations.

open.text: Not an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Says its platform explicitly serves international candidates alongside students and starters in hospitality.

growth.text: Founded in 2011 and still small at 2-10 staff; it says it grew to hundreds of connected hotels and thousands of vacancies a year.

worth_knowing.text: Some postings under this name are for hotels using the platform (e.g. Odyssey Hotel Group), so check who the actual employer is.
